notes.title: Major Update: "Ignited in Cavern" Now Supports English!
notes.notes:
This update adds English language support and adjusts the layout of some buttons and text.

To celebrate the Steam Visual Novel Festival from 3.4 to 3.11, we have updated some promotional images and logos in the store.

During the festival, we are offering a 10% discount and a special bundle, "Love and Gamble," which includes Ignited in Cavern and Zero-Sum Heart.

We sincerely thank the volunteers of the English localization team for their efforts.

English Localization Team (in no particular order):
Ze
Yaoguang
Lin Tian
Nattraven
KurenaiX
Yukari
Joanna
Yun

notes.title: The official release date for "Ignited in Cavern" is set for April 12th.
notes.notes:
This is the "Shāngguān Production Team". We want to express our gratitude to many friends for their help and testing. The official version will be launched on April 12th.

Priced at 1.99 USD, with a 10% discount for the first week.

We offer "Milk Paste and Fish from Luoshui" and look forward to meeting you.

For a brief overview of the story and important notes, please refer to the store page.

Special thanks to Zheng Xiaoshuang for the promotional graphics.
